labels.title: Strands disagree
labels.description: The site has supporting and opposing reads, and a supporting read lies on another strand than an opposing one.

labels.title: A read disagrees
labels.description: At a decided site, a supporting or uninformative read that bounds the item shows it whole, or through the end its strand reaches first, as another sequence than the decision.

labels.title: Possible point heteroplasmy
labels.description: Both strands read the position cleanly, and a read on each strand shows the same second base above its threshold, not a neighbour's base. Per-read shares and thresholds are in the position's reads.

labels.title: Second base on one strand
labels.description: One strand alone reads the position cleanly; its call's second peak has cause second_template, exceeds the run-signal threshold of its key, and is not a neighbour's base.

labels.title: Long run, length unconfirmed
labels.description: A decided run at least review.run_growth bases longer than its reference run, whose length rests on an anchored end or on a single supporting read.

labels.title: Single-read deletion at a region edge
labels.description: A decided deletion that rests on a single read within review.edge_zone positions of a reportable region's first or last position.

labels.title: Single-read deletion in a run
labels.description: A decided site resting on a single read whose call is at least review.run_growth bases shorter than a reference run of at least review.phase_run bases.

labels.title: Site not decided
labels.description: The consensus site is contested (a tie) or unresolved (no clean observation), or its call holds an N.

labels.title: Difference excluded from the call
labels.description: The consensus decided another sequence than the reference, and the call step excluded it: no call lies within one position.

labels.title: Run end not read
labels.description: The site holds a run whose length is phase_loss or reference_frame, so its 3' end is not callable; runs whose length the profile leaves unrecorded are not listed.

labels.title: Covered, not callable
labels.description: Positions outside every site that admitted reads cover but none makes callable.

labels.title: No reads
labels.description: Positions no admitted read covers.

labels.title: Single supporting read
labels.description: A variant site with exactly one supporting read.

labels.title: Support on one strand
labels.description: Every supporting read of a variant site lies on one strand.

labels.title: Run end from a dephased tail
labels.description: A run's length rests on an anchored end: the first masked call reading another base after the run marks its end (ADR-0071).

labels.title: Read-end margin
labels.description: The call is unmasked but neither trusted nor exempt: inside the read-end margin, untrimmed, or next to a masked call.

labels.title: Masked, still anchors
labels.description: The call is masked but still anchors the alignment; from is the first position of the read's masked stretch that reaches the item.

labels.title: Masked signal
labels.description: The call is masked for a reason other than an anchoring phase shift; reason is the modality's mask reason, verbatim.

labels.title: Dephased
labels.description: Superimposed ladders offset by slippage: the read's callability segment is dephased.

labels.title: Phase mixture
labels.description: A stretch after a run whose signal the modality asserts is the read's own sequence superposed with copies offset by whole calls (ADR-0082). Display only.

labels.title: One strand only
labels.description: Positions that reads of one strand alone make callable.
